description: This file defines a theme configuration for terminal output, utilizing the 'chalk' library for coloring text and referencing a palette for color values. It includes logic for detecting whether color output should be enabled based on environment variables, and exports functions and objects related to terminal theming and colorization.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Checks if the current terminal supports colored output based on the 'chalk' level.

methods.name: colorize
methods.description: Applies color to a string if the terminal supports rich formatting; otherwise, returns the string unmodified.

ctags.name: baseChalk
ctags.pattern: /^const baseChalk = process.env.NO_COLOR && !hasForceColor ? new Chalk({ level: 0 }) : chalk;$/

ctags.name: colorize
ctags.pattern: /^export const colorize = (rich: boolean, color: (value: string) => string, value: string) =>$/
